chunks: Whatever is in it from Bashīr al-Nabbāl, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Bashīr al-Nabbāl.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: A distinguishing appellation for Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.بَشِيرِ النَّبَّالِ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the named transmitter.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a term indicating direct report transmission by the author.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Bashīr al-Nabbāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Bashīr al-Nabbāl. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith attribution within the book.
